toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans says 'hul eie winkel'; "'n eie winkel" sounds wooden.
toegepas.fout: 'n eie fietswinkel' is stiff; Afrikaans naturally says 'hul eie'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same meaning, and 'hul eie fietswinkel' is the natural possessive a fluent writer would use.

toegepas.blok: Vlieg is meer as net opstyg
toegepas.voor: Jy moet ook kan draai en jy moet
toegepas.na: Jy moet ook kan draai, en jy moet
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Jy moet ook kan draai' and 'jy moet die vliegtuig reguit kan hou' are two full sentences joined by 'en', so the AWS comma is required.

toegepas.blok: Vlieg is meer as net opstyg
toegepas.voor: Beheer beteken die vlieënier self besluit
toegepas.na: Beheer beteken dat die vlieënier self besluit
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without 'dat' the clause needs main-clause word order; adding 'dat' makes the verb-final order correct.
toegepas.fout: Without 'dat' the clause has verb-final word order, which is ungrammatical in a main-clause complement.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'dat' makes the existing word order correct without changing what beheer means.

toegepas.blok: Vlieg is meer as net opstyg
toegepas.rede_vinder: A flight ends 'op die grond' in Afrikaans; 'by die grond' is the wrong preposition.
toegepas.fout: 'by die grond geëindig' is an unnatural preposition for where a glide ends.
toegepas.rede_keurder: In both versions the glide starts on a dune and ends when it reaches the ground; 'op die grond' is the natural preposition and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: in plaas van om af te gly
toegepas.na: in plaas daarvan om af te gly
toegepas.rede_vinder: Before an 'om ... te' clause the standard form is 'in plaas daarvan om'.
toegepas.fout: 'in plaas van om ... te' is the colloquial form; the standard form before an om-clause is 'in plaas daarvan om'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain grammar correction with no change in meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die hoogte was op' is unnatural; 'opgebruik' says plainly that the height was used up.
toegepas.fout: 'die hoogte was op' is an odd, easily misread use of 'op' for 'used up'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'opgebruik' says plainly that the height was spent, which is exactly what the original meant, and a Grade 4 reader will not stumble on it.

toegepas.voor: Een van die broers was self aan boord en hy kon
toegepas.na: Een van die broers was self aan boord, en hy kon
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Een van die broers was self aan boord' and 'hy kon die vliegtuig stuur' are two full sentences joined by 'en'.

toegepas.voor: Hy het gemaak dat die vliegtuig
toegepas.na: Die enjin het wel gesorg dat die vliegtuig
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hy' can be read as the brother from two sentences earlier, and 'het gemaak dat' is an anglicism; naming the engine with 'gesorg dat' fixes both.
toegepas.fout: 'Hy' can be read as the brother who was 'hy' two sentences earlier, and 'het gemaak dat' is wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the engine removes the pronoun doubt; 'wel' only marks the contrast with the previous 'nie', so the same engine still does the same thing.

toegepas.voor: vliegtuie gebou en het self leer vlieg
toegepas.na: vliegtuie gebou en self leer vlieg
toegepas.rede_vinder: The repeated 'het' is unnecessary and makes the sentence clumsy.
toegepas.fout: The repeated 'het' makes the coordinated verb phrase clumsy.
toegepas.rede_keurder: One 'het' governs both verbs; the people and actions are unchanged and the sentence reads more smoothly.

toegepas.voor: Nuwe enjins was sterker en vlieëniers
toegepas.na: Nuwe enjins was sterker, en vlieëniers
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Nuwe enjins was sterker' and 'vlieëniers kon hul masjiene beter beheer' are two full sentences joined by 'en'.

na_skrywer.voor: Die deel aan 'n voël of vliegtuig se sy waarmee dit vlieg.
na_skrywer.na: Die deel aan die sy van 'n voël of vliegtuig waarmee dit vlieg.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: "aan 'n voël of vliegtuig se sy" is an awkward possessive; 'aan die sy van' reads naturally.
na_skrywer.fout: The possessive 'aan 'n voël of vliegtuig se sy' is awkward.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition and the change rewords it beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it, for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Hulle het gesien hoe 'n voël se vlerke buig en hoe hulle draai.
vlae.rede: 'hulle' could mean the wings (grammatically nearest) or birds or the brothers; the intended referent (wings twisting, or the bird turning) cannot be fixed without guessing the content.

vlae.teks: Die broers se glyvlugte was verby sodra daardie hoogte op was. Dan hoef 'n vlug met 'n enjin nie te eindig nie.
vlae.rede: The glide-flight sentence sits between the two engine sentences, so 'Dan' follows a sentence about glides and the flow breaks; moving it would reorder content, so the writer should decide.
